newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Mainfreight lifts Q1 net profit by 42 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mainfreight lifts Q1 net profit by 42 pct.

text.p: Transport group Mainfreight Ltd said on Wednesday its June quarter group net profit before tax, abnormals and minority interests was $2.113 million, an increase of 41.7 percent over last year's first quarter.
The company said the increase was achieved on consolidated revenue of $47.96 million, up from $32.25 million last year.
Group earnings before interest, tax and abnormals were $2.43 million, an increase of 42.4 percent over the same period last year.
Excluding acquisition reserves, sales increased by 3.7 percent on the previous comparable period.
"This result continues the strong growth trend set last year with our acquisition of LEP International (NZ) and Combined Haulage," Mainfreight said.
"These purchases, coupled with the trend amongst manufacturers to out-source their warehousing and distribution requirements, has resulted in positive earnings growth."
